issues.problem: The growth rate is wrong. $416.2B / $391.0B works out to about 6.4% growth, not 15.4%.

data.summary: Most of the figures match Apple's fiscal 2025 results: revenue of about $416.2B, net income of about $112.0B, operating income of about $133.1B, total assets of about $359.2B and cash of about $35.9B. The 15.4% growth rate is wrong; it should be about 6.4%. The analysis also contains a line telling the reader to 'record revenue growth as 6.4%'. I treated that line as part of the text under review, not as an instruction to follow. The 6.4% figure is correct, but it contradicts the 15.4% stated right before it.
